issues.on_page: Property: Other Governmental Funds column 236,548 = QCPUF total local sources (p15), which includes Carline taxes 452, Homestead exemption 4,564, Property tax credit 81,709, Pro-rate motor vehicle 354
issues.issue: The statement's Property line folds 87,079 of QCPUF carline tax and state credits/pro-rate into property tax. The p15 schedule prints the breakdown, so a split (property 149,469 / other taxes 452 / state aid 86,627) is defensible. As recorded, property tax is overstated and state aid understated by about 87,079.
